title: How does a delivery tracker know where your order is?

scenes.text: Your order is on the road. So how does the shop know exactly where it is?
First, the delivery person taps start. Their phone asks permission to share its location.
The phone works out where it is, by listening to signals from satellites in space.
Every few seconds, it sends that position to the shop's server.
The server then works out the road route, and the next turn.
And it pushes every new position straight to your screen. No refreshing.
The dot moves on the map until it reaches your door. Then you tap, I received my order.
I built this for my final year project. Comment TRACK, and I will show you how.
